svg.title: TOPAK H2 — The decision records, ADR-0001 to ADR-0052, by area
svg.desc: Every record with its status and confirmation markers at G10, and its amendments since G9. Solid blue edges are dependencies taken from each record's "Depends on" line, drawn where both records sit in the same row of tiles (every tile lists its full line); the grey edge is the one supersession; red dashed edges are the reversals in effect (ToO §8.3) and ADR-0040's.

Tile colour is status: blue Accepted (genesis), red Accepted with a confirmation marker (C1–C4, ADR-0029 §4), dashed blue Accepted · provisional (ADR-0029 A4: in force, subject to redesign, confirmation required), amber Proposed,
"bootstrap set": ADR-0024 to 0027, which cannot carry a marker (ADR-0029 §4); three of them hold a provisional amendment, which the genesis attestation must name (G10 §1.2).
"§1–§5, §7, §8": ratified in part; ADR-0022 §6 stays Proposed. ADR-0042 is whole since Batch 30.
A note names amendments since G9 with their batch (G10 §6).
46 Accepted: 18, 26 confirmation-required and 2 provisional (0050, 0052); 2 in part · 3 Proposed (0035, 0036, 0051; and ADR-0022 §6) · 1 superseded · 1 tombstone · 1
reserved: 51 files, numbered to 0052, six added since G9.
Batches 27 to 35 since G9: ADR-0005 ratified (B27); ADR-0047 to 0050 and 0052 and twenty-six dependent amendments in seventeen records (B34). No amendment pending,
down from four; ADR-0026 A1 (R8) withdrawn (W1).
Reversals in effect (ToO §8.3), all by the author alone in genesis: 0008 by 0038 (superseded); 0017's ordering-primacy clause (supersession unwritten, open item 6, as at G9);
